title: Gold. Buy or Sell?
speaker: A1 Trading host

macro_themes.view: 2-year near 5% (4.93) and 10-year at 5.2% keep climbing; headwind for gold alongside oil and a stronger dollar.
Fed might actually start raising rates; Warsh was surprisingly hawkish at the last FOMC.
Both sides discussing a phased plan to reopen the Strait within 7 days; a deal would mean lower oil, lower yields, softer dollar and bullish gold.

calls.condition: Long while gold holds the 61.8% retracement (~4242); stop just below, re-buy lower if stopped
calls.reason: Gold refuses to break the 61.8% fib despite rising yields, oil and dollar and a hawkish FOMC, showing relative strength; possible Iran deal is a bullish catalyst.
calls.quote: I go ahead and take a stab long on gold with the last line of defense at 61.8% retracement level with small size

notes: No weekday/date stated; listing date kept. Entry level not stated precisely (near 4242 support); stop 'near this level of support'. Small size, so conviction low.
